description: React component for the Pickup screen in a food delivery web app, involving map interactions, restaurant listing, and cart management.

methods.name: onCompleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when the GraphQL query for restaurants completes, sets loader to false.

methods.name: navigateClearCart
methods.description: Asynchronously clears the cart and navigates to the selected restaurant page.

methods.name: checkCart
methods.description: Checks if the selected restaurant is different from the current cart's restaurant, prompts for cart clearing if needed.

methods.name: toggleClearCart
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the clear cart modal.

methods.name: handleLoad
methods.description: Handles Google Map load event, stores map instance reference.

methods.name: searchArea
methods.description: Refetches restaurant data based on the current map center.

methods.name: onClickMarker
methods.description: Handles marker click, scrolls to the corresponding restaurant element.

methods.name: showMessage
methods.description: Displays a message to the user.
